message.text: The s3presign runner is the component. I am reading its source and server.go to find the schedule and exact wiring lines.
Checking where `startBackgroundRunners` is called to locate the server startup wiring.

The component is `s3presign` in `server/runner/s3presign`.

It runs every 12 hours. It is wired into server startup at `server/server.go:129` inside `Server.Start`, via `s.startBackgroundRunners(ctx)`.

h01.
s3presign Runner — every 12 hours — server/server.go:129

The `s3presign` runner (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`) re-presigns S3 attachment URLs so stored links stay valid (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`). `Server.Start` hooks it in via `s.startBackgroundRunners(ctx)` in `server/server.go:129`, which constructs the runner, runs it once, then starts `Run` in a background goroutine.
